title: food storage containers large
text: food storage containers large. I have purchased these in the past - and I come back to buy them.  They do say they are reusable, washable, microwavable (never microwave plastic items), OK to freeze, etc.. however - they have a shelf life.  They won't last like the thicker, better made food storage items - but you can get a few uses out them.  Their Achilles heel are really the lids - they break easily when trying to remove them.  So there is a learning curve in placing and removing the lids.  They are sort of clear.  So you can identify the contents.  You can write on them with permanent markers.  All in all for the price and how long they survive (about a 6-12 uses) I think they are a reasonable purchase. I buy all three sizes - but the medium size is the one I run out of first.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
